author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Tower Farm DLC Map Reveal Trailer for Halloween: The Game, the hit asymmetrical action horror game developed by Illfonic. Players can check out the upcoming map, with Tower Farm being added to the game as the annual harvest festival commences. Explore the map inspired by Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers with Tower Farm in Halloween: The Game, launching on October 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Acornia: Mirror Worlds, an upcoming bake-and-brawl management adventure game. Acornia: Mirror Worlds will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.

Take a look at the full baking process (that’s a gameplay loop here in Acornia) as you follow Alva through the first dungeon floors, fighting a boss, farming, automating, baking and crafting - and even decorating as you restore the old family dessert shop!
title: Acornia: Mirror Worlds - Official Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Return to Azure City and join Justina in solving one of the biggest mysteries yet in Paper Perjury 2: Shadow of Justice. Watch the reveal trailer for Paper Perjury 2: Shadow of Justice, an upcoming detective visual novel follow-up to 2024's Paper Perjury by Paper Cat Games. Paper Perjury 2 directly follows the original game’s DLC cases and continues Justina’s clerk-turned-detective career as she uncovers potential corruption in the Azure City Police Department. 

In Paper Perjury 2: Shadow of Justice, a criminal is on the loose! A serial thief has evaded capture for far too long. In pursuit of catching this masked criminal, the Azure City Police Department is tearing itself apart. Solve cases and outsmart criminals in a detective story where the shadow of justice looms over everyone.

Paper Perjury 2: Shadow of Justice will be available on PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2028. 

The trailer also announces that the original game, Paper Perjury
title: Paper Perjury 2: Shadow of Justice - Official Reveal Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a peek at gameplay from Splizards in this teaser trailer for the upcoming cooperative survival adventure game. Float through the cosmos on a meteor as a Splizard. Gather drifting resources, craft tools and expand your meteor into a traveling base. Swarms of bloodthirsty space mosquitoes lurk in the darkness, and powerful monsters guard the secrets of survival. Splizards will be available on PC.
title: Splizards - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Official Announcement Trailer for Silk & Sorrow, a hand-drawn dark fantasy co-op adventure built exclusively for two players. Start your journey in Winter 2027 when a demo featuring Chapter 1 arrives.

The game tells the story of two orphans, Silk and Sorrow, who stumble into the Chrysalis, a hidden world where everything humanity has discarded ends up. Together, they must explore a haunting landscape built from the forgotten remnants of the world above, survive its twisted horrors and corrupted inhabitants, and bring light back to the Chrysalis. Guiding them through the darkness is Glint the Glowgrub, a small but vital companion whose glow lights the way.

Silk & Sorrow can be played in both couch co-op and online co-op, with players needing to communicate, solve problems, and trust one another to survive a world where every step brings new dangers and unsettling discoveries.

Silk & Sorrow is coming to PC via Steam, with Chapter 1 releasing as a demo in Winter 202
title: Silk & Sorrow - Official Announcement Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Crown Must Hold announcement trailer for this upcoming game from HypeTrain Digital and Zelart. The Crown Must Hold trailer showcases tower defense gameplay, deckbuilding, and a peek at the story. Crown Must Hold will be available on PC. You can sign up for the playtest if you're interested.
title: Crown Must Hold - Official Announcement Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this announcement trailer for Rotten Crown, an upcoming unique settlement builder with tons of blood and dark humor. Rotten Crown is a twisted real-time settlement manager where no problem ever fully dies. Grow your tiny kingdom, turn opposition into workers, balance the needs of humans and zombies, and make decisions no respectable ruler would ever admit to. 

Rotten Crown will be available on PC. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested, and sign up for an open playtest that will be held soon.
title: Rotten Crown - Official Announcement Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for The Forge: Steel Frontier, an upcoming mech action game. The Forge: Steel Frontier will be available on PC. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4489960
title: The Forge: Steel Frontier - Official Announcement Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Cinematic Launch Trailer for Valor Mortis, a first-person action RPG developed by One More Level. Players will traverse a plague-ridden battlefield under Napoleon's army. Wield a suite of weapons, master abilities, and bring a conspiracy to light. Don't miss the cinematic look for Valor Mortis, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: Valor Mortis - Official Cinematic Launch Trailer

description: Get a look at the Reveal Trailer for Aquamorta, an upcoming first-person horror adventure game developed by 43 Studios. Players will navigate a desolate swamp town with a community that's encroaching on the bounds of hysteria. Explore abandoned buildings and discover the forgotten tale of what's transpired. Aquamorta is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Aquamorta - Official Reveal Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Akiiwan: Relaxing Survival trailer for this upcoming game. Fall into a chill survival adventure, with a talking campfire as your guide. Explore, craft, fish and hunt during the day, and ask your fire three questions each night. Choose wisely: Winter isn't the only surprise in this beautiful, hand-drawn world. Playable in cozy or realistic mode. 

Akiiwan: Relaxing Survival will be available on PC, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch 2. An extended demo is out now on Steam.
title: Akiiwan: Relaxing Survival - Official Demo Announcement Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026

description: Don't miss the Game Overview for There are No Ghosts at the Grand, a first-person adventure game developed by Friday Sundae. There are No Ghosts at the Grand is launching into Early Access in December 2026 for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Cloud, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).

description:

Moonfrost is out now in Early Access on PC.
